Hartwell J M Limited Partnership Has Lowered Its Holding in Luxoft Holding (LXFT) by $12.64 Million as Stock Value Declined; Oracle (ORCL) Holder Wedge Capital Management L LP Boosted Stake by $13.10 Million
May 19, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Hartwell J M Limited Partnership decreased its stake in Luxoft Holding Inc (LXFT) by 66.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership sold 229,850 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.59% with the market. The hedge fund held 117,270 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.53M, down from 347,120 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership who had been investing in Luxoft Holding Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.40 billion market cap company. It closed at $41.9 lastly. It is down 31.27% downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.82% the S&P500.
Wedge Capital Management L LP increased its stake in Oracle Corporation (ORCL) by 26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wedge Capital Management L LP bought 278,660 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.18% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.35M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $63.85 million, up from 1.07M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wedge Capital Management L LP who had been investing in Oracle Corporation for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $189.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $0.22 $46.32. About 13.52 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 1.20% uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.35% the S&P500.

The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, February 15 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. Monness Crespi & Hardt maintained Luxoft Holding, Inc. (NYSE:LXFT) rating on Monday, January 4. Monness Crespi & Hardt has “Buy” rating and $84 target. Wedbush downgraded Luxoft Holding, Inc. (NYSE:LXFT) rating on Friday, August 11. Wedbush has “Hold” rating and $5000 target. The rating was maintained by UBS with “Buy” on Tuesday, July 28. The stock has “Neutral” rating by UBS on Monday, November 20. The stock of Luxoft Holding, Inc. (NYSE:LXFT) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, November 12 by Monness Crespi & Hardt. Sterne Agee CRT initiated it with “Buy” rating and $60 target in Thursday, March 24 report.
Hartwell J M Limited Partnership, which manages about $535.54M and $532.32M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 19,000 shares to 101,550 shares, valued at $17.19 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Procter & Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 4,413 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,148 shares, and has risen its stake in Amazon.Com (NASDAQ:AMZN).
Analysts await Luxoft Holding, Inc. (NYSE:LXFT) to report earnings on May, 24 before the open. They expect $0.39 earnings per share, down 15.22% or $0.07 from last year’s $0.46 per share. LXFT’s profit will be $13.06M for 26.86 P/E if the $0.39 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.67 actual earnings per share reported by Luxoft Holding, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -41.79% negative EPS growth.
